get.description:
List customer invoices and credit notes

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`, `customer_invoices:readonly`

parameters.description:
Cursor for pagination. Use this to fetch the next set of results.
The cursor is an opaque string returned in the previous response's metadata.
Leave empty for the first request.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Number of items to return per request.
Defaults to 20 if not specified.
Must be between 1 and 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
You can choose to filter items on specific fields.
Available fields and values:
- `id`, `date`, `customer_id`, `billing_subscription_id`, `quote_id`: `lt`, `lteq`, `gt`, `gteq`, `eq`, `not_eq`, `in`, `not_in`
- `invoice_number`: `eq`, `not_eq`, `in`, `not_in`
- `draft`: `eq` (boolean)
- `credit_note`: `eq` (boolean)
- `external_reference`: `eq`
- `flow_id`: `eq`, `not_eq`, `in`, `not_in`
- `category_id`: `in`
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description:
You can choose to sort items on specific attributes
Sort field may be prefixed with `-` for descending order.
Example : `id` will sort by ascending order, `-id` will sort by descending order.
Available fields : `id`, `date`
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description:
You can choose to include additional related resources in the response.
When specified, related resources will be returned in a separate `included` section.

⚠️ **Warning**: This feature is currently experimental and may change or be removed in future releases.
We recommend using it with caution in production environments.

electronic_billing_address.description:
The electronic billing address used for the e-invoicing routing of this invoice.
The address comes from the e-invoicing directory, for example `123456789` or `123456789_00012`.

It is null when:
- the invoice is imported without a conversion to an e-invoice.
- the company could not send e-invoices when the invoice was finalized.
- the customer has no electronic billing address and no SIREN, such as an individual.
- the invoice is a draft.
- the imported e-invoice file is still being processed.

It is set later when:
- the draft invoice is finalized.
- the imported e-invoice file is processed.

post.description:
This endpoint allows you to import an invoice. Amounts are stored exactly as provided — Pennylane does not recalculate or round them.

ℹ️ **Amount consistency:** The amounts you send must be internally coherent:
- `currency_amount_before_tax + currency_tax` must equal `currency_amount`.
- The sum of invoice line `currency_tax` values must match the invoice-level `currency_tax`.
- The sum of invoice line `currency_amount` values must match the invoice-level `currency_amount`.

Small rounding differences are tolerated. When `convert_to_e_invoice` is `true`, stricter requirements apply — see that field's description.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires the following scope: `customer_invoices:all`

parameters.description: Numeric ID of the company to act on. Required when authenticating with a firm token. Ignored when the token is already bound to a company.
parameters.name: X-Company-Id

allOf.description: Invoice amount in euros (total value of the invoice in euros). If the currency is euro, `currency_amount` and `amount` are identical.

contract_reference.description: Contract reference (e-invoice field BT-12). Maximum 50 characters.

convert_to_e_invoice.description:
When set to `true`, Pennylane will asynchronously convert the imported invoice
into a Factur-X e-invoice (PDF/A-3) by embedding a structured XML into the
provided PDF. The invoice is returned immediately in the response; the
conversion happens in the background shortly after.
Requires `file_attachment_id` to reference a PDF file, all invoice lines to
have a `label`, and `invoice_number` to not exceed 35 characters and only
contain alphanumeric characters and `-+_/`.

The attached PDF must **not** already embed a Factur-X (or ZUGFeRD) XML.
If it does, the request can fail with an error asking you to use the customer
e-invoice import endpoint (`/customer_invoices/e_invoices/imports`) instead.
Use `convert_to_e_invoice` only for plain PDFs that Pennylane should convert.

**Important:** The three mandatory French legal notices ("Late payment
penalties", "Fixed recovery cost for late payment", and "Early payment
discount") are required. Either provide them in `legal_notices`, or configure
them in the footer of the default invoice template of your Pennylane account.
Without either, the request returns a 422 error.

**Factur-X amount compliance (BR-CO-14/BR-CO-15):** The Factur-X XML standard
requires the sum of line-level `currency_tax` values to equal the invoice-level
`currency_tax` exactly, and `currency_amount_before_tax + currency_tax` to equal
`currency_amount` exactly. A difference of even a few cents will produce a
non-compliant XML. Ensure your amounts are fully consistent before sending.

credited_invoice_id.description:
ID of an existing customer invoice in Pennylane that this credit note credits.
The imported document must have negative amounts (a credit note).
The referenced invoice must exist in the same company, belong to the same
customer, be finalized (not a draft), not itself be a credit note, and have
enough remaining amount to absorb the credit note.

All amounts must be provided after discount — no recomputation is performed. Use `relative` for a percentage discount and `absolute` for a fixed amount discount.

When it is not sent, null, or an empty string, the electronic billing address of the customer is used.

Unlike customer invoice create, import does not auto-fill fields from `product_id`, and `product_id` is not checked against `substance`.

When provided together with `ledger_account_id`, both must refer to the same account. If they do not match, the request returns 422.

`goods` is a supply of goods, `services` is a supply of services,
and `goods_and_services` is both. `null` means the type has not been chosen.
This is not invoice line `substance`.
Omit this field to keep the invoice template default. Send `null` to clear it.

transaction_reference.description: By adding this field you can automatically reconcile the newly imported invoice with a transaction. See documentation about [automatic payment matching](https://pennylane.readme.io/v2.0/docs/automating-payment-matching).

banking_provider.description: The banking provider for the transaction

provider_field_name.description: Name of the field that you want to match

provider_field_value.description:
Value that you want to match.

With `banking_provider: stripe` or `gocardless`, the value is matched exactly against the reference with the same `provider_field_name` synced from that provider, on non-archived transactions.

With `banking_provider: bank` and `provider_field_name: label`, every non-archived bank transaction whose label contains this value as a whole word is matched, including transactions already matched to other documents. The match is case-sensitive, and a value that does not start and end with a letter, digit or underscore never matches. Use a value that identifies a single payment, such as a card transaction ID: a merchant name or a short generic value groups unrelated documents together. Pass the literal string `invoice_number` to match on this invoice's number instead of a fixed value.

Other combinations do not match any transaction.

In all cases, matching runs again on every update of this invoice.

provider_field_value.description:
Value that you want to match.

With `banking_provider: stripe` or `gocardless`, the value is matched exactly against the reference with the same `provider_field_name` synced from that provider, on non-archived transactions.

With `banking_provider: bank` and `provider_field_name: label`, every non-archived bank transaction whose label contains this value as a whole word is matched, including transactions already matched to other documents. The match is case-sensitive, and a value that does not start and end with a letter, digit or underscore never matches. Use a value that identifies a single payment, such as a card transaction ID: a merchant name or a short generic value groups unrelated documents together. Pass the literal string `invoice_number` to match on this invoice's number instead of a fixed value.

Other combinations do not match any transaction.

In all cases, matching runs again on every update of this invoice.
